definitions: int nonnegative_sum(const std::vector<int>& xs) { int total=0; for(int x:xs) { if(x>=0) total+=x; } return total; }
original_observations: The running total is 4, 4, 4, 10.
The body runs zero times; the initial total is the result.

definitions: int clamp_reading(int x,int low,int high) { if(low>high) throw std::invalid_argument("reversed bounds"); return std::max(low,std::min(x,high)); }
original_observations: 12 is above the upper bound, so the function returns 10.
The reversed interval raises invalid_argument before computing a result.

definitions: std::optional<int> parse_int(std::string_view s) { int out=0; auto [ptr,ec]=std::from_chars(s.data(),s.data()+s.size(),out); if(ec!=std::errc{} || ptr!=s.data()+s.size()) return std::nullopt; return out; }
original_observations: All two characters are consumed, yielding 42.
The x remains, so the field is rejected despite a valid numeric prefix.
The sorted bag is [0,1,3,3], preserving both threes.
The empty sum is 0, and begin equals end.

definitions: std::vector<int> doubled(const std::vector<int>& xs) { auto out=xs; for(int& x:out) x*=2; return out; }
program_bodies: const std::vector<int> xs{2,4}; auto ys=xs; ys[0]=99;
original_observations: An owned result [4,8] survives the temporary argument.
xs stays [2,4]; ys becomes [99,4].
A paid record contributes 200 cents.
Pending contributes zero to settled revenue while retaining its original amount.

definitions: std::vector<std::string> read_lines(std::istream& input) { std::vector<std::string> out; std::string line; while(std::getline(input,line)) out.push_back(line); if(input.bad()) throw std::runtime_error("read failed"); return out; }
original_observations: Exactly two lines, with no extra stale third line.
The final line without newline is still read once.

definitions:
int add(int,int);
int add(int a,int b) { return a+b; }
program_bodies:
assert(add(0,0)==0);
std::cout << "zero inputs link and run too\n";
original_observations: One declaration and one matching definition form a valid single-file demonstration.
A declared but undefined called symbol compiles to an object, then fails to link.

definitions: int twice(int x) { return x*2; }
original_observations: The process returns nonzero if the result is wrong, including Release builds.
NDEBUG changes assertions, not ordinary if-based contract checks.

definitions: std::optional<int> parse_reading(std::string_view s) { int n=0;auto [p,e]=std::from_chars(s.data(),s.data()+s.size(),n);if(e!=std::errc{}||p!=s.data()+s.size()||n<0)return {};return n; }
original_observations: Three accepted, two rejected, total 35.
Zero remains valid, while a numeric prefix with trailing junk is rejected.

definitions: struct Tracked { int* live; explicit Tracked(int& count):live(&count){++*live;} ~Tracked(){--*live;} Tracked(const Tracked&)=delete; Tracked& operator=(const Tracked&)=delete; };
original_observations: p is empty, q owns the integer 7.
live rises to 1 in scope and returns to 0 at destruction.

definitions: struct Batch { std::vector<int> values; std::string label; };
original_observations: a remains [1,2]; b becomes [9,2].
b receives the old values; assigning a new valid value to a is safe.
Zero is a present successful integer.
The error alternative carries an inspectable reason.

definitions: int sum_view(std::span<const int> xs) { return std::accumulate(xs.begin(),xs.end(),0); }
original_observations: The view of positions 1 and 2 sums to 10.
The borrowed prefix is al while text remains alive and stable.

definitions: struct Score { int id; int points; };
original_observations: For [-1,0,3], traversal yields 0 and 3.
Records order by points while carrying their original IDs.

definitions:
#include <concepts>
template<std::integral T> T identity_sum(T a,T b) { return a+b; }
original_observations: Deduction selects int and the result is 5.
double does not satisfy this integral-only interface.

definitions:
struct Cents { long long value; bool operator==(const Cents&)const=default; };
Cents operator+(Cents a,Cents b){return Cents{a.value+b.value};}
original_observations: The API retains cents units and produces 125 cents.
Zero is the addition identity for this bounded domain.

definitions: std::string encode(int id,int cents){return "v1,"+std::to_string(id)+","+std::to_string(cents);}
original_observations: The exact wire text is independent of struct padding.
The path joins components using platform rules; filename is batch.csv.

definitions: extern "C" int add_checked(int a,int b,int* out) noexcept { if(!out)return 1; if((b>0 && a>std::numeric_limits<int>::max()-b)||(b<0 && a<std::numeric_limits<int>::min()-b))return 2; *out=a+b;return 0; }
original_observations: Status 0 publishes value 5 through the caller-owned pointer.
Null output pointer returns status 1 without dereferencing it.

definitions: std::vector<int> reversed(std::vector<int> xs){std::reverse(xs.begin(),xs.end());return xs;}
original_observations: The independent golden example fixes the intended meaning of reversal.
Applying reversal twice restores the original sequence.

definitions: int checked_at(const std::vector<int>& xs,std::size_t i){return xs.at(i);}
original_observations: Index 1 selects 4.
Checked access rejects index 2 instead of invoking unchecked access.

definitions: int total(const std::vector<int>& xs){return std::accumulate(xs.begin(),xs.end(),0);}
original_observations: Known input gives 12 before any measurement.
The checksum is 12000; elapsed nanoseconds vary by run.

definitions: namespace vendored { constexpr int api_version=1; constexpr int add(int a,int b){return a+b;} }
original_observations: The expected source API version is pinned at compilation.
A consumer still checks behavior instead of trusting a version label.

definitions:
struct Record { int id; int cents; };
std::optional<Record> parse_record(std::string_view s){ auto cut=s.find(',');if(cut==s.npos)return {};int id=0,cents=0;auto [p,e]=std::from_chars(s.data(),s.data()+cut,id);auto [q,f]=std::from_chars(s.data()+cut+1,s.data()+s.size(),cents);if(e!=std::errc{}||f!=std::errc{}||p!=s.data()+cut||q!=s.data()+s.size()||id<0||cents<0)return {};return Record{id,cents};}
original_observations: The library produces an owned record with exact fields.
A trailing suffix rejects the complete record.

program_bodies: int answer=0; std::thread t([&]{answer=42;}); t.join(); assert(answer==42);
original_observations: After join the result is 42 and the borrowed local is still alive.
A stop flag requests cooperation; the owner still waits for termination.
The consumer proceeds only when work exists or shutdown has been published.
A closed empty queue ends consumption; closure does not discard queued work.
Each increment is indivisible; two workers making 1000 increments produce 2000 after join.
An acquire load observing this store can safely read the preceding payload write.

definitions: int checked_square(int x){if(x<0)throw std::invalid_argument("negative task");return x*x;}
original_observations: The future yields 9 and waits for completion if necessary.
The worker failure is observed by the caller through get.
The owner receives explicit evidence that the worker reached the named phase.
Two sets of 100 atomic increments must total 200 in each trial.

definitions: struct Sample { int id; int value; };
original_observations: Three full records retain the relationship between identity and value.
The value-only representation yields the same total 60.
The index holds 2->2, 3->1, 4->1.
A non-mutating lookup reports absence without inserting key 9.

definitions:
constexpr int square(int x){return x*x;}
consteval int fixed_limit(){return 16;}
original_observations: The compiler validates the expression before an executable exists.
The same constexpr function may be evaluated during program execution.

definitions: template<std::ranges::input_range R> std::vector<int> keep_positive(R&& xs){std::vector<int> out;for(auto x:xs)if(x>0)out.push_back(x);return out;}
original_observations: The owned result is [2,2], retaining multiplicity after the temporary input dies.
An empty range produces an empty owned result.

definitions: std::optional<int> safe_add(int a,int b){if(a<0||b<0||a>std::numeric_limits<int>::max()-b)return {};return a+b;}
original_observations: The operation rejects the input before evaluating an overflowing sum.
The binary floating result is close within this declared absolute tolerance.
One successful create has exactly one matching destroy; initial value is 0.
Null handle is rejected without dereferencing it.

definitions: bool safe_id(std::string_view s){if(s.empty()||s.size()>16)return false;for(unsigned char c:s)if(!((c>='a'&&c<='z')||(c>='0'&&c<='9')||c=='_'))return false;return true;}
original_observations: The seven-character identifier uses only the allowed alphabet.
Dot and slash violate the narrow identifier grammar.

definitions: constexpr int release_schema=1;
original_observations: The release check remains active even under NDEBUG.
The result names a schema version, input count and exact checksum.

definitions: long long serial_total(std::span<const int> xs){return std::accumulate(xs.begin(),xs.end(),0LL);}
original_observations: The independent serial oracle is exactly 21.
Two disjoint partitions combine to 21 after both workers finish.
